title: Enumeration of certain permutation group polynomials
summary: We construct a new family of permutation group polynomials over finite fields of odd characteristic and explicitly provide its companion. Moreover, we precisely determine the number of permutation group polynomials of this form and those that are equivalent to this new family. In addition, we completely solve the problem of enumerating permutation group polynomials of the various forms presented in Hasan and Kumar (2026), as well as permutation group polynomials which are equivalent to these families.
